items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: how could Sam say that was Andrew's band at the Happy Landing?

ctx.x: So who else did you have in the band at Happy Landing?

Well, at the Happy Landing, when I first went to the Happy Landing it was Israel band. Let's show you how it alternates around that you can understand what I meant about you playing with different fellas. Well it was a misunderstanding between Israel and the band. So we all quit. And the people at the Happy Landing want to know why we all quit and sent for me. And that's because they get the same band back without Israel. Then I hired Andrew Morgan to play in the band. And then the band, which was Sam, come up…
Well anyway, who else was in the band?
